short_caption: Four wooden market stalls with lanterns along a canyon dirt path
literal_description: A dirt path runs from the foreground into a narrow canyon between tall red-brown rock walls. Two wooden market stalls with tiled roofs stand on each side of the path, each with a wooden counter and glowing yellow hanging lanterns. Wooden crates, barrels with metal hoops and brown clay jars stand on the counters and on the ground beside the stalls. A wooden signpost with a hanging iron ring stands at mid distance left of centre. Flat grey stones are set in the dirt and tufts of green grass grow at the path edges. The camera is at standing eye height looking level down the path toward blue-tinted distant cliffs and a dark blue sky.
environment: Outdoor dirt path in a narrow canyon with steep red-brown rock walls, grass patches on ledges and a dark blue sky.
visual_style: stylised low-poly game art, soft painterly shading, smooth simplified shapes
lighting: Dusk; cool dim blue ambient light from the sky, warm orange-yellow point light from hanging lanterns pooling on the stalls and path, soft shadows, moderate contrast
atmosphere: blue haze in the far canyon, warm glow around lanterns
ambient_sound: soft wind through a rock canyon, faint creak of hanging lanterns and wooden beams, distant evening insects
ground_type: packed dirt path with flat stones and grass tufts
backdrop: canyon rock walls and distant cliffs
